# letterpress

Render HTML to PDF through Chromium's own print engine. Real vector text,
exact page box, tagged PDF, heading bookmarks. Bun only, zero npm
dependencies.

## Key files
- README.md — full usage, findings reference, alternatives
- src/cli.ts — CLI entry: render, validate, page, mcp
- src/mcp.ts — Model Context Protocol server (stdio + HTTP /mcp)
- package.json — name: letterpress; bin: letterpress -> src/cli.ts;
  engines: bun >= 1.4

## Install
bun add github:muhammedanasmithadi/letterpress#v0.1.3

## MCP config
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "letterpress": {
      "command": "bun",
      "args": ["/path/to/letterpress/src/cli.ts", "mcp"]
    }
  }
}

## Not Deno Deployable
Bun-locked (Bun.stdin, Bun.serve, Bun.file, ...). Requires Bun >= 1.4.
